program_name: Online Bachelor of Arts in African and African American Studies

programme_facts.value: This African and African American studies degree will provide you with essential critical thinking and communication skills that support a variety of careers. You’ll be especially prepared for diversity and inclusion-related jobs as a social worker, multicultural assistant or diversity officer. Graduates from this program pursue careers in journalism, teaching, social policy, civil rights activism and more.
